checks.name: gn_secondary_tree
checks.description: Errors when the change adds or edits a Bazel build file (BUILD.bazel, BUILD, .bzl) under build/secondary/ (GN-only overlay tree for third-party code), adds a //build/secondary/... dependency to a Bazel file elsewhere, or adds a bazel2gn third_party_target_map.json entry pointing into build/secondary/; such code must move (in a separate CL below the migration) to the //third_party/<name>/src layout with BUILD.gn and BUILD.bazel in //third_party/<name>/, using new_local_repository with a Fuchsia build file when upstream's own BUILD/WORKSPACE makes src/ a separate Bazel package.

checks.name: migration_sanity
checks.description: Deterministic check for BUILD.bazel/BUILD.gn dual-build parity: rejects target-level # @bazel2gn:skip on convertible library/binary/reference/rustc_check_cfg_build_flags/fuchsia_structured_config_rust_lib/fx_component_manifest/fx_component targets (except package-private testonly helper targets consumed only by Bazel tests in the same package, host binaries wrapped by a pre-sentinel bazel_host_tool target, filegroup targets paired with inputs-only GN source_set wrappers, and pre-existing skipped targets in ancillary packages outside PLANTER_TARGET_DIRS), rejects keeping a hand-written install_host_tools() or bazel_host_tool() above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL while bazel2gn still generates the underlying host binary (rustc_binary, go_binary, executable, cc_binary) below the sentinel (dual_built_host_tool), rejects unreferenced # @bazel2gn:skip packaging/component helper targets (resource, fuchsia_package_resource_group, fx_component_manifest, fx_packaged_binary, fx_component, fx_test_component, fx_unittest_component) in BUILD.bazel that duplicate a non-convertible target kept above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL in BUILD.gn when no target in BUILD.bazel depends on them (unused_skipped_duplicate_target), rejects # @bazel2gn:skip on test targets or test attributes (with_unit_tests, with_host_unit_tests, test_deps) in sentinel packages unless a valid skip condition holds (target under test in the same BUILD.bazel is skipped, fx_unittest_package has resources, host test has data/test_data/test_label, test binary rule is unsupported by bazel2gn, the skip already existed at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE, or a human explanatory comment precedes # @bazel2gn:skip; unjustified_test_skip), reports a test skip whose comment starts with '# Needs reviewer attention (bazel2gn skip):' (the dual-testing cost exception, which only a human can confirm) as INFO test_skip_needs_reviewer_attention instead of rejecting it, rejects a test skip that did not exist at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE, has no technical skip condition and is justified only by an unmarked comment as unjustified_test_skip (agent-added skips must use the marker or meet a technical condition), rejects a new marked or commented skip on a test whose target under test (followed through same-package test and testonly references, stopping at the first library) is an sdk_*() library other than sdk_source_set() (idk_cc_shared_library, idk_cc_static_library and their _zx variants; sdk_library_test_skip), and notes in the INFO finding when the target under test is in another package and can't be verified, rejects convertible GN targets (including fuchsia_component_manifest, fuchsia_component, check-cfg config() targets and fuchsia_structured_config_rust_lib, which bazel2gn translates, while allowing targets with GN-only attributes/constructs like forward_variables_from or concurrent_jobs, inputs-only GN source_set wrappers for non-code files, and pre-existing pre-sentinel targets in ancillary packages) and unused .gni imports left above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL in BUILD.gn (unused_gn_import), requires assembled fuchsia_package targets whose binary depends on a rustc_dylib to stay in BUILD.gn with their bundles/assembly/bazel_inputs bridge until //build/bazel/debug_symbols/aspects.bzl collects rust_dylib_library (fx_package_missing_rust_dylib_debug_symbols), verifies that packages wired into bundles/assembly/BUILD.bazel that use fuchsia_structured_config_* have //tools/configc:bazel_input($host_toolchain) in _AIB_TOOLS_DEPS in bundles/assembly/bazel_inputs/BUILD.gn (missing_assembly_bazel_input_tool), and records INFO gn_unmodified/missing_sources/attribute_alignment/dep_alignment coverage for non-bazel2gn or exports_files-only packages, *_test.go files from a base GN go_library moved to a same-package host_go_test/go_test embedding it, migrated rustc_check_cfg_build_flags targets, rustc_* compile_data/rustc_env/lint_config attributes, fuchsia_* -> fx_* rule/package mappings (including Pass-2-paired fx_package and fuchsia_system_package/fuchsia_test_package targets), and multi-line gn-format-wrapped `deps =` variable concatenations below the sentinel; when build/bazel/rules/testing/fx_test.bzl exists, also rejects GN test packages (fuchsia_unittest_package, fuchsia_test_package) duplicated by a BUILD.bazel fx_package or fx_unittest_package of the same name, GN test packages that only package C/C++ or Rust tests Bazel can build (a BUILD.bazel cc/fx_cc binary or rustc_* unit test, or a GN test executable with only C/C++ sources whose deps all have a Bazel build) and use no GN-only features, which should be migrated to fx_unittest_package (or fx_test) + bazel_test_suite, and unrolled fx_packaged_binary + fx_component_manifest + fx_test_component unit tests with newly added standard .cml manifests (including manifests whose non-runner/syslog shards map to expect_includes() targets that fx_unittest_package auto-includes via aspect_hints) when fx_unittest_package / fx_unittest_component suffices (unrolled_unittest_package), while recording INFO gn_test_kept_above_sentinel for a rustc_test dual-built below the sentinel and packaged by a GN test package kept above the sentinel due to GN-only blockers; tests of unknown language never trigger it. A GN package named <Bazel test package>-gn is accepted only when the Bazel test package uses fx_package, fx_unittest_package(resources = [...]), or an unsupported test binary rule (otherwise duplicate_test_above_sentinel). While a library has users in both build systems its tests run in both and bazel2gn generates their GN copies, so tests without # @bazel2gn:skip are expected; a hand-written GN rustc_test/go_test above the sentinel that duplicates a Bazel test is duplicate_test_above_sentinel, an unpackaged/host GN rustc_test/go_test left above the sentinel when all of its dependencies have Bazel targets (in the working tree or on origin/main) and it uses no GN-only features is gn_test_not_migrated, and a package-private testonly helper consumed only by skipped Bazel tests without # @bazel2gn:skip is orphaned_test_helper. Also rejects GN-only constructs (exclude_toolchain_tags values, configs -=, disable_syslog_backend, forward_variables_from, concurrent_jobs pools, toolchain-qualified labels such as "<label>($current_toolchain)") that a change adds to a bazel2gn-generated target below the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL without a BUILD.bazel source: a # @bazel2gn:raw_attribute/raw_overwrite/value_overwrite/path_overwrite annotation containing it, disable_instrumentation/disable_build_flags, or a dedicated tag/attribute that the checkout's build/tools/bazel2gn sources implement (exclude_toolchain_tags=<tag>, assert_no_deps_<toolchain>=<label>, a large RBE worker exec_properties/tag for concurrent_jobs.rust_highmem, $(execpath <label>)/compile_data labels for toolchain-qualified references to them) (unsanctioned_gn_construct_below_sentinel, a hand edit that the next fx bazel2gn run drops); such sanctioned lines are accepted, GN-only lines in a dependency's generated section no longer mark that package as GN-blocked, and a convertible target kept above the sentinel only for GN-only constructs gets an INFO gn_only_attr_target_kept_above_sentinel pointing at the annotation recipe. When the checkout's bazel2gn converts fx_compiled_manifest to GN cm() and passes restricted_features through (detected from literals in build/tools/bazel2gn/*.go), fx_compiled_manifest counts as a convertible Bazel rule, cm (manifest/output_name/config_values_package_path/restricted_features) as a convertible GN template, and restricted_features no longer keeps a fuchsia_component_manifest above the sentinel. Also rejects load() of symbols re-exported by a *:defs.bzl file from same-directory .bzl files (e.g. @rules_cc//cc:defs.bzl, @rules_rust//rust:defs.bzl, //build/bazel/rules/rust:defs.bzl) in a checked package (defs_bzl_reexport_load); load each symbol from the .bzl file that defines it (e.g. @rules_cc//cc:cc_library.bzl, //build/bazel/rules/rust:rustc_library.bzl), while allowing defs.bzl files that define their symbols directly such as //build/bazel/rules/host:defs.bzl.

checks.name: gn_dep_parity
checks.description: Compares every migrated GN target's dependency labels and edge kinds with its BUILD.gn at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE, in every changed package that keeps a BUILD.gn (following GN groups the target newly depends on, and mapping a pure single-target forwarding group("<outer>") whose same-package target :<inner> was folded directly into <outer> to compare :<inner>'s dependencies against <outer>): errors when a dependency was swapped for a sibling target of the same package (e.g. a GN-only *_static wrapper carrying link settings replaced by the library it wraps), when a removed dependency carried link-affecting settings (except a test_deps entry of a target whose GN unit test moved to Bazel, i.e. that no longer sets with_unit_tests), or when a public_deps edge with public_configs became private without the configs being re-exported as all_dependent_configs (bazel2gn emits Rust deps as private GN deps); reports dependencies no target of the package uses anymore as INFO.

checks.name: gn_attr_parity
checks.description: Errors when a GN target of a changed package had a GN-only attribute that no plain BUILD.bazel attribute carries (exclude_toolchain_tags, configs -=, disable_syslog_backend, toolchain-qualified assert_no_deps entries such as "//third_party/rust_crates:serde_json5($current_toolchain)"), set in its body or through forward_variables_from(<scope literal>, ...), at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE and the target in the current BUILD.gn lost it (converted by bazel2gn without naming it, removed, or BUILD.gn deleted): preferably keep the target generated and name the attribute on its BUILD.bazel target (# @bazel2gn:raw_attribute, disable_instrumentation/disable_build_flags, or the dedicated tags the checkout's bazel2gn documents), otherwise keep it hand-written above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL (migration_sanity accepts the Bazel # @bazel2gn:skip for them); without it coverage builders fail to link or excluded tests run in sanitizer builders. Exception: rustc_library/rustc_staticlib pass exclude_toolchain_tags only to their with_unit_tests test and rustc_macro ignores it, so for them losing it is accepted when the base target had no with_unit_tests or a hand-written GN <name>_test keeps the same values. Also errors when a migrated target in BUILD.gn drops a custom `name`, `output_name`, or `crate_name` from $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE (gn_custom_output_name_dropped), when a bazel2gn-generated rustc_test without a disambiguated `crate_name`/`output_name` collides in root_out_dir with another package's binary or same-named rustc_library (duplicate_gn_output_name), when retained hand-written GN targets or group("tests") above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL are newly wrapped in `if (...)` platform/toolchain conditions that were absent at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE (unrequested_gn_condition), when base GN test `args` are dropped/modified or Rust test rules pass `env RUST_BACKTRACE=0` instead of `env RUST_LIB_BACKTRACE=0`, or when a C/C++ target (fx_cc_library, cc_library, fx_cc_binary, cc_binary, cc_test) in a checked package or a referenced third_party/rust_crates/compat crate omits a local header file on disk referenced by a quoted #include across any preprocessor branch (including non-default target CPUs such as riscv64/arm64) from srcs/hdrs/textual_hdrs (undeclared_cc_local_header). Also records INFO missing_sources/attribute_alignment/dep_alignment/unit_test_parity coverage for GN targets matched by name, output_name, or source list (including cross-package relative `../` GN source paths mapped to canonical `//<owner_pkg>:<rel_path>` Bazel source labels, GN output_name/name preserved via @bazel2gn:raw_overwrite or hyphen-to-underscore crate_name/binary_name normalization, GN test_specs.log_settings.max_severity mapped to max_log_severity on fx_test / fx_unittest_package, GN args carried over via Bazel args/select() or host-test test_args, GN test-package deps and unit-test test_deps expect_includes targets moved to aspect_hints of the unit_tests binaries, GN data_deps preserved via @bazel2gn:raw_attribute or companion test_data / host_test_data_* targets, top-level GN list variables, Rust build_flags/lint_config config mappings, with_unit_tests decomposition, custom GN attributes preserved via @bazel2gn:raw_attribute, config() -> build_flags() and fuchsia_* -> fx_* / ffx_plugin / ffx_tool rule/attribute mappings, @bazel2gn:raw_attribute / @bazel2gn:path_overwrite dependency mappings, deps via forward_variables_from(<scope literal>, ...), third_party_target_map.json C++ dependency mappings, and expected IDK/zx_library attribute mappings and rustc_library_with_features expansions).

checks.name: gn_target_type_parity
checks.description: Verifies that a migration keeps what GN builds. With bazel2gn (BUILD.gn kept), no converted GN target may change type: a source_set() must not become a static_library() (the cc_library needs alwayslink = True) or vice versa, and no other template may change (e.g. an sdk_source_set, or a GN-only wrapper template). When a GN target is removed (full removal), the cc_library/fx_cc_library of the same name in BUILD.bazel must set alwayslink = True if and only if it was a GN source_set(). Exception: when build/bazel/rules/testing/fx_test.bzl exists, a GN test package (fuchsia_unittest_package, fuchsia_test_package, fuchsia_test) or host test (python_host_test, host_test) may become a same-named bazel_test_suite exporting its migrated Bazel tests (C++ or Rust); a GN rustc_test, go_test or test may likewise become a same-named bazel_test_suite; a GN cc_test_executable may become the testonly executable bazel2gn generates from a same-named Bazel fx_cc_binary(testonly = True) (INFO cc_test_executable_converted), while a GN C++ test() that became an executable() (from fx_cc_binary(testonly = True)) is an ERROR test_became_executable when build/bazel/rules/cc/fx_cc_test.bzl exists, because fx_cc_test syncs back to test(); a GN host binary or install_host_tools target (rustc_binary, go_binary, executable, install_host_tools) may become a bazel_host_tool (or a forwarding group in a BUILD.gn that defines a bazel_host_tool); a GN fuchsia_package or fuchsia_package_with_single_component migrated to fx_package in BUILD.bazel may retain a thin bazel_fuchsia_package wrapper (or forwarding group) in BUILD.gn; a rustc_library_with_features target may expand into explicit rustc_library targets when all of its feature_sets variants are also generated as rustc_library targets; and a pure single-target forwarding group("<outer>") whose sole same-package convertible target :<inner> has no external callers may fold :<inner> directly into <tmpl>("<outer>"). Also emits INFO findings for benign review_diff rule and third_party_target_map.json dependency mappings (such as GN test to Bazel host_*_test or fuchsia_package to fx_package/bazel_fuchsia_package) so planter's review_diff check deduplicates them.

checks.name: visibility_audit
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel visibility attributes for package-level default_visibility, missing target visibility, exports_files() without visibility, overly narrow sprawling visibility lists (>15 entries across >=6 areas on globally-used platform libraries/test utilities that should use 2-3 level subsystem area rollups from find_rdeps per_target_recommended_visibility, top-level subtrees, or ["//:__subpackages__"] for codebase-wide libraries), //visibility:public outside build/bazel_sdk/ (including exported test targets such as fx_test, fx_unittest_package and wrap_host_*), redundant :__pkg__, disguised public wildcards, multi-domain umbrella wildcards, cross-area depth-2 wildcards, overbroad depth>=3 LCA wildcards, false-positive rdeps, and uncovered rdeps (packages whose BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel depend on the target or on a generated <target>_<suffix> sub-target such as a fidl_library's <fidl>_rust/<fidl>_cpp bindings, including internal-tree callers the local product graph does not build, that no visibility entry covers; references to generated sub-targets count as rdeps of the owning target), and records non-blocking INFO visibility_narrowed coverage when GN visibility narrowing is confirmed intentional by the audit (such as dropping packages that only reference :tests/:benchmarks or a split-out unit test target). Broad visibility on test/test-support targets requires callers in >= 2 areas, except cml_shard/expect_includes targets, which are consumed through .cml includes rather than BUILD deps.

checks.name: build_only_scope
checks.description: Fails if the migration change (HEAD commit, uncommitted, or untracked files) modifies any non-build file (anything other than BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel/BUILD/*.BUILD.bazel/*.BUILD/*.gni/*.bzl/MODULE.bazel/*.MODULE.bazel). Migrations must not edit source code, except minimal compile-fix edits (without lint-suppression annotations) to existing source files in a migrated package whose BUILD.gn at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE had no targets in the configured GN build graph (<build dir>/ninja_outputs.json) and suffered pre-existing source bitrot. A newly added non-shard .cml file is also allowed when the nearest BUILD.bazel declares an fx_test_component whose manifest points at it (hand-written test manifest replacing the one GN's fuchsia_unittest_package generated, for C++ and Rust tests alike), and an existing <pkg>/README.md in a migrated package directory is allowed when every modified line only updates a //<pkg> target label reference, as is a byte-identical .cml manifest relocated from an out-of-package path referenced by the pre-migration BUILD.gn into its owning Bazel package (along with removing the pre-migration .cml copy). An untracked agent report file (CoderReport*.json) at the checkout root is not part of the change and is only noted as INFO (untracked_agent_report_ignored); a committed copy still fails.

checks.name: lint_config_parity
checks.description: Flags lint-driven source edits (removed .clone(), added #[allow]/#[expect]/NOLINT, removed use imports, let _ =) in non-build files with file:line evidence, and warns when a BUILD.bazel lint_config outside //build/config/rust/lints fails to resolve to a rust_lint_config that includes the default clippy and rustc lint sets (Bazel replaces default lints, GN appends).

checks.name: shared_config_reuse
checks.description: Flags lint-config and GN build-argument indirection and duplication in the change: new alias() targets that only re-export a rust_lint_config (or lint-named config), dict literals in changed BUILD.bazel/.bzl files that copy the default clippy/rustc lint entries owned by //build/config/rust/lints instead of loading its exported .bzl constants, dual-build lint_config labels without a same-named GN config() in the label's package (bazel2gn copies lint_config verbatim), LINT.ThenChange references newly broken by moving lint dicts, and GN declare_args() build arguments duplicated in .bzl/BUILD.bazel instead of being exported via //build/bazel:gn_build_variables_for_bazel to @fuchsia_build_info//:args.bzl with LINT.IfChange/ThenChange comments.

checks.name: bazel_minimality
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel and .bzl files for unwrapped external C/C++ or Rust rules (cc_library/cc_binary from @rules_cc// instead of fx_cc_library/fx_cc_binary from //build/bazel/rules/cc/..., and rust_* from @rules_rust// instead of rustc_* from //build/bazel/rules/rust:rustc_*.bzl), redundant default attributes (`crate_name == name`, unnecessary `crate_name` on crate unit-test `rustc_test` targets unless disambiguating the `bazel2gn` GN `output_name`, `output_name/out == name`, `version = "0.1.0"` on internal `rustc_*` targets, default `crate_root`), commented-out dependency or source labels in BUILD.bazel list attributes (`deps`, `srcs`, etc.), host platform constraint parity (`HOST_OS_CONSTRAINTS` vs disallowed `@platforms//host:constraints.bzl` `HOST_CONSTRAINTS`, and preserving GN `if (is_host)` guards via `target_compatible_with = HOST_OS_CONSTRAINTS`), redundant single-target forwarding `alias(name = "<outer>", actual = ":<inner>")` indirection when `:<inner>` has no external callers and its crate/output name already matches `<outer>`, unit-test `rustc_test` targets that repeat library `srcs` without `crate = ":<lib>"` (unless a `testutils` dependency swap requires a standalone `rustc_test` with a concise comment above `rustc_test` justifying why `crate` cannot be used without redundant `rustc_test`/`non_test_deps` boilerplate), single-use top-level `_`-prefixed variables, `wrap_host_rust_test` naming (`<base>-host-test`) for `rustc_library_with_features` packages, single-platform `srcs = select({..., "//conditions:default": []})` workarounds that should use target_compatible_with, legacy host-tool macros (go_binary_host_tool, py_binary_host_tool) missing caller package visibility on //build/bazel/versioning:is_api_level_PLATFORM, private external rule load() paths or duplicate public/private rule imports, inline-expanded GN read_file() lists missing LINT.IfChange/LINT.ThenChange, `@bazel2gn:path_overwrite` entries for unmigrated GN-only deps or missing FIDL bindings that use real Bazel targets or multi-label packing instead of one documented `# @bazel2gn:skip` filegroup per overwritten path with a unique name derived from the path, redundant `@bazel2gn:path_overwrite`/`@bazel2gn:raw_overwrite` annotations on rules `bazel2gn` does not translate (such as `host_cc_test`) or on third-party labels already mapped in `build/tools/bazel2gn/third_party_target_map.json` (redundant_bazel2gn_overwrite), genrule commands added by the change that derive paths or arguments in the shell ($$(dirname $(location <one input>)), $$(python3 -c ...), backticks) or hard-code bazel-out/ paths instead of Bazel's predefined genrule variables ($@, $<, $(SRCS), $(execpath), $(@D), $(RULEDIR)) and Starlark values, copyright header year validation on newly added Starlark files (with INFO coverage when newly added BUILD.bazel files already use the current year or pre-existing modified BUILD.bazel files retain their original copyright year), buildifier formatting and buildifier_lint warnings, and unauthorized edits to shared Bazel rules/macros under //build/bazel/ or unrelated packages outside the target directory.

checks.name: cq_reachability
checks.description: Verifies that migrated test targets (including bazel2gn-generated GN test copies below ## BAZEL2GN SENTINEL in dual-build BUILD.gn files, and host-toolchain test references :<name>_test($host_toolchain) present in base BUILD.gn) and group("tests") remain wired into group("tests") in BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel outside bazel_test_suite, that unit tests present in base BUILD.gn (with_unit_tests = true) are migrated to BUILD.bazel (including wrap_host_rust_test when base BUILD.gn ran the test on $host_toolchain), and that every main-repository `//<pkg>:...` dependency (direct or transitive across newly migrated/stacked packages, including lint_config, component/resource attributes, and modified ancestor test_suite BUILD.bazel files) in a migrated BUILD.bazel resolves to an existing `<pkg>/BUILD.bazel` or `<pkg>/BUILD` in the checkout (erroring with missing_bazel_dependency_package when missing so CQ tests.json `bazel query` does not fail with `no such package`, and reporting INFO stacked_bazel_dependency_package when provided by an unmerged stacked parent commit above origin/main with guidance on preserving the stack during rebase, even when $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE points to the base of the stack). When build/bazel/rules/testing/fx_test.bzl exists, also verifies that every Bazel fx_test, fx_unittest_package and host test (host_rustc_test, wrap_host_rust_test, host_py_test, host_test, host_go_test, the <name>_test of rustc_* with_unit_tests = "host"/"both", and test_suite expansions) in a changed package is listed in a GN bazel_test_suite (fx_test and fx_unittest_package in target_tests, host tests in host_tests) that is wired (directly or via intermediate groups) into group("tests"), standardized_test_groups("tests"), or standard root test groups (host_tests, hermetic_tests, non_hermetic_tests, e2e_tests, tests_no_e2e), since fx test and infra only see Bazel tests through bazel_test_suite, and requires wiring into the nearest existing ancestor BUILD.bazel test_suite (target_tests or host_tests) exported by an ancestor bazel_test_suite—or creating and wiring a flat ancestor area test_suite + bazel_test_suite in //<area>/BUILD.bazel and //<area>/BUILD.gn when none exists yet—instead of adding a per-package bazel_test_suite in the leaf BUILD.gn (bypassed_ancestor_test_suite, redundant_local_bazel_test_suite), and flags duplicate_gn_list_assignment / duplicate_bazel_target. The GN copy bazel2gn generates for a dual-build library's test runs the GN build of the test, so it never replaces exporting the Bazel test. Every Rust device test binary (rustc_test, or the <name>_test of with_unit_tests = "fuchsia"/"both") must be packaged by an fx_packaged_binary or fx_unittest_package for an fx_test (unpackaged_rust_device_test). Also verifies that the change merges cleanly onto the latest origin/main (refreshing a stale local origin/main ref and running git merge-tree --write-tree against HEAD) without rebase conflicts, leftover conflict markers, or local prerequisite ancestor commits / Depends on: references that have already landed on origin/main (stale_landed_parent_commit) so Gerrit CQ (jiri patch) does not test against a stale parent or fail with Failed to rebase. Also errors when a migrated BUILD.bazel lists in `includes` (or any dependency attribute) a `*.shard` label whose existing package does not declare that target (missing_bazel_dependency_target), so the missing cml_shard is caught before `fx bazel build` fails analysis with `no such target`.

checks.name: confidentiality_check
checks.description: Blocks internal vendor subpaths, internal domain names, personal email addresses, user handle mentions, and reviewer/person names from being added in the change.

checks.name: gn_format
checks.description: Mirrors the CQ static-checks gn_format step: runs `gn format --dry-run` on every GN file (BUILD.gn, *.gni, *.gn) the change adds or modifies anywhere in the checkout (including verification .gni lists and parent groups edited by hand) and errors when one is unformatted or unparsable.

checks.name: commit_message_format
checks.description: When HEAD (or @ in a jj colocated checkout) is the task's commit, warns if the subject does not follow '[bazel_migration][<subsystem>] //<migrated dir>' or, when the directory's git log has no established subsystem tag (no parent subsystem) or adding [<subsystem>] would push the full //<migrated dir> subject over 65 characters, '[bazel_migration] //<migrated dir>' (or an abbreviated '//.../<suffix>' subject <= 65 characters without trailing punctuation); flags leaf-directory tags, missing tags against git log history, subjects truncated to an unmodified parent directory, and enforces shac commit_msg line-length limits (subject <= 65 chars, body lines <= 72 chars excluding URLs, indented code blocks, and footers). A target directory build/secondary/<dir> (GN-only overlay) is expected as //<dir>, where gn_secondary_tree requires the migration to land, and a change that modifies no file versus its parent (nothing migrated, e.g. blocked) gets INFO commit_subject_empty_change instead of subject warnings. Also requires one or more unwrapped 'Bazel-Migration-Target: //<dir>:<target>' footers for every non-empty migration commit (scoped to targets newly migrated in the commit, excluding pre-existing BUILD.bazel targets, internal packaging/test-binary wrapper targets, /BUILD.gn file paths, and # @bazel2gn:skip targets whose GN definitions remain hand-written above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL in BUILD.gn), requires a non-empty 'Skip-Readme-Check: <reason>' footer whenever files under third_party/ (outside third_party/rust_crates/) with an enclosing README.fuchsia are modified without modifying that README.fuchsia (mirroring the shac third_party_readme_update check), rejects unwarranted 'Cq-Include-Trybots:' footers when the migrated build files have no matching architecture-specific conditionals and no source files were modified for bitrot repair, and verifies that all footers are in a single contiguous block at the bottom of the commit message without blank lines separating them from Change-Id. Also lints Test: footers: fx bazel without --config=, Bazel labels without leading @, redundant //a/b:b labels, :all builds instead of the migrated test target, shac/bazel2gn verification not written as the single last line 'Test: fx host-tool shac check', and Test: footers that run migrated tests directly when an ancestor BUILD.bazel test_suite() includes them (prefer that suite or the GN group reaching it); reports as INFO when no ancestor test_suite() includes the migrated tests (developer must choose one). Also lints the body: rejects single- or multi-line body paragraphs that merely restate the '[bazel_migration] //<dir>' subject line (including boilerplate 'and generate the corresponding GN targets using bazel2gn' clauses; commit_body_redundant_title), rejects 'Migrate ...' sentences claiming to migrate targets (including # @bazel2gn:skip test targets) that remain hand-written in BUILD.gn or claiming to sync BUILD.gn via fx bazel2gn when BUILD.gn was not modified (commit_body_claims_unmigrated_target), rejects non-checkout-relative paths prefixed with .jiri_root/worktrees/<name>/ or host filesystem paths (commit_msg_non_checkout_path), redundant 'Also migrated in this change:' bullets that duplicate the primary migrated directory (commit_body_redundant_also_migrated), and bare 'Also migrated in this change:' directory bullets ('- //<dir>') or bare subject directories when <dir>/BUILD.gn still defines unmigrated targets (also_migrated_partial_directory / commit_subject_partial_directory, requiring specific '::<target>' labels), requires pre-existing source bitrot compile fixes in unbuilt GN packages to be mentioned and explained in the body (commit_body_unmentioned_source_fix), requires .bzl/MODULE.bazel edits outside the migrated directories (not specific to the migrated targets) to be described in the body, and requires the body not to name underlying rules (rust_library, rust_test, cc_library, ...) that no migrated BUILD.bazel calls directly, and not to present a crate_name that differs from its target name (or <crate_name>_test) as a target name.

checks.name: test_data_attribute
checks.description: Flags test-only files (test_data/, testdata/, tests/, fixtures, golden paths) listed in the runtime `data` attribute of a BUILD.bazel rustc_library/rustc_binary/rustc_proc_macro that defines unit tests (with_unit_tests/with_host_unit_tests); they belong in `test_data` (or a host_test_data() target), not `data`, and must not be worked around by editing shared rule macros or sources.

checks.name: build_verification
checks.description: Builds the change: `fx build` (the configured product graph, which can leave out the migrated packages' tests and many GN dependents), then `fx build <labels>` for GN targets the product graph may leave out (the changed packages' :tests groups and test binaries, and GN tests, binaries and libraries in other packages that depend on a changed package, limited to labels in the GN graph; catches GN-only link failures such as undefined operator new after a dependency label or edge changed), `fx host-tool shac check` (shac static checks on the change, including `verify_bazel2gn` BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel drift, building `fx build --host //bundles/buildbot/static_checks` and retrying when a host static-check tool is missing or out of date), and `fx bazel build --config=fuchsia_platform --noexpand_test_suites` / `--config=host` of `//<dir>:all` for every changed directory with a BUILD.bazel (skipping `test_suite`-only aggregator packages under `--config=fuchsia_platform` and excluding `_validate_json_action` targets such as `<fidl>_validate_ir_json` and `<config>_fidl_internal_validate_ir_json` from top-level `:all` so `assert_no_deps_aspect` does not crash on their scalar `data` attribute), plus commit `Test:` footer validation for consolidating to `<= 3` `Test:` lines, unconfigured GN labels, `fx test` targets missing from `<build dir>/tests.json`, bash syntax errors (unquoted toolchain parentheses), and unexcluded `_validate_json_action` targets. Set PLANTER_SKIP_BUILD=1 to skip builds, PLANTER_BUILD_DRY_RUN=1 to list the shell-quoted commands. Also runs `fx bazel test --config=host` on the changed packages' Bazel host tests (host_rustc_test, wrap_host_rust_test, host_go_test, host_py_test, host_test), and after the GN build reports as INFO whether each exported bazel_test_suite test reached <build dir>/tests.json (fx_test is only built, never run with fx bazel test). When `fx build` fails only in Bazel actions of targets in another git repository than the change that have no Bazel dependency path (fx bazel query somepath) to any changed package, in native GN/Ninja Rust or Python mypy/build-time-test actions (`--transdeps` or `--library_infos` / `.mypy_checked`) outside the changed packages with no dependency path to any changed package, or in Ninja on missing source files in an out-of-sync submodule/subrepository outside the changed packages, and the change touches no .bzl/MODULE.bazel, the failure is reported as INFO preexisting_failure_gn_build (out-of-sync checkout or pre-existing upstream failure) and the remaining steps still verify the change.

checks.name: tests_json_parity
checks.description: Reports every Fuchsia device test and host test that is in <build dir>/tests.json at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE but not after the change (test_dropped_from_tests_json, ERROR). Device tests match by package URL; host tests by name or by label ignoring the toolchain and `@@`, so a GN host test replaced by an exported Bazel host test of the same label is kept. Both sides come from `fx gen` with the changed packages' :tests groups appended to args.gn as test roots; the baseline is generated once per change base by temporarily writing the $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE version of the changed files into the working tree (backed up and journaled in <git dir>/planter-tests-json-parity, never overwriting files edited in between; HEAD and the index are untouched). Skipped (INFO) with PLANTER_SKIP_BUILD=1; PLANTER_BUILD_DRY_RUN=1 reports the plan.

checks.name: speculative_unit_test
checks.description: Errors when a migrated Rust library gains a unit test that did not exist in GN: a BUILD.bazel rustc_test(crate = ":<lib>") without own srcs, or with_unit_tests on the rustc_library/rustc_binary, whose crate sources contain no test functions (#[test], #[cfg(test)], #[<runtime>::test]) while the library's GN target at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE had no with_unit_tests or GN <name>_test (speculative_empty_unit_test); such tests produce empty test binaries and packages, also copied into BUILD.gn by bazel2gn, that no suite runs.

checks.name: cc_header_deps_and_annotations
checks.description: Warns when a BUILD.bazel in a target directory gains a # @bazel2gn: directive (skip, raw_attribute, raw_overwrite, value_overwrite, path_overwrite) without a human comment above the target, attribute, or list entry (or the opening line of the list a closing-bracket directive sits on) explaining why Bazel and GN differ (undocumented_bazel2gn_directive; one comment may cover a stacked group, and a documented directive covers identical ones in the same file; directives already present at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE are ignored), and flags C/C++ libraries (fx_cc_library, cc_library, idk_cc_source_library*) that list in implementation_deps a dependency whose headers a local hdrs file #includes, which must be in deps so bazel2gn emits GN public_deps (public_header_dep_in_implementation_deps: ERROR for FIDL <lib>_hlcpp/<lib>_cpp bindings matched by <fuchsia/.../cpp/...> or <fidl/<lib>/cpp/...>, WARNING for <x/...> or <lib/x/...> includes matching a label's package directory name).

checks.name: dual_built_host_tool
checks.description: Consolidated into migration_sanity.sh (dual_built_host_tool category): errors when a changed BUILD.gn keeps a hand-written install_host_tools() (or bazel_host_tool()) above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL whose deps/bazel_target name a host binary (rustc_binary, go_binary, executable, cc_binary) that bazel2gn still generates below the sentinel.
